title: Riley Green's Fans Are Like Taylor Swift's Swifties, Tour Opener Says [Exclusive] - NewsBreak
text:
By Evan Paul ,
7 hours ago Rebecca Sapp / Jamie Squire, Getty Images Riley Green just wrapped up the summer leg of his Damn Country Music Tour. Drake White , who opened the shows, had a lot to say to Taste of Country Nights about the experience — especially Green’s fans.
We asked White what it was like in the pit and at the merch stand at Green’s shows. He lit up with a huge smile, admitting, “it’s pretty unbelievable.”
White says Green’s fans tend to be younger women who are very devoted to their favorite artist — a loyalty he likens to Taylor Swift ‘s fans, who are collectively known as Swifties.
“The 15-year-old to 20-year-old girl in the pit, is — man, as far as monetarily, that is the fanbase, ’cause the dad’s gotta buy all the merch. It’s like the Taylor Swift thing,” he explains.
Swifties are known for buying up Swift’s merch and selling out items at her merch stand, and they’re dialed into every aspect of her music. Green’s fans are similar, he says.
Download the TasteofCountry Mobile App Now White couldn’t stop gushing over his buddy Riley Green in general — he admires how hard the singer-songwriter works, and stresses that he’s not just a pretty face, even if that’s part of Green’s appeal, too. He writes his songs and puts his heart and soul into his craft, and it shows onstage and by the company he keeps (his fans).
How Many Hit Songs Does Riley Green Have? Riley Green is no slouch when it comes to climbing up the charts: He has five No. 1 songs under his belt, with his latest being “Worst Way.”
What Happened to Drake White? Drake White had a stroke onstage in the middle of a performance in August of 2019. He has since recovered and is thankful that he still can do what he loves to do, which is play country music. He’s currently promoting his new single “Nuthin’ But a Smile.”

Hickerson/Kim Penz, Zeitlin Sotheby's International Realty Riley Green Country Stars Who Are Having Babies in 2025 The country music family is expanding in 2025. These country singers are all making space for new bundles of joy this year. Some are first-time parents, while others are already experts at this "parenting" thing, but every new arrival is sure to be equally sweet. Keep scrolling to see photos of all the stars who will become parents in 2025. Gallery Credit: Carena Liptak Terry Wyatt, Getty Images Baby's Here! Shay Mooney + Hannah Billingsley Mooney Dan + Sh﻿ay 's Shay Mooney was perhaps the first country star to welcome a baby in 2025. His wife Hannah gave birth to their fourth child — and fourth baby boy — on Jan. 20. Aubrey Ellis Mooney joins big brothers Ames, Asher and Abram. Monica Schipper, Getty Images Baby's Here! Emmy Russell + Tyler Ward Ameri﻿can Idol star Emmy Russell (who also happens to be Loretta Lynn 's granddaughter) announced in late 2024 that she was pregnant with a baby girl.
Russell gave birth on Jan. 31, but her labor and delivery experience wasn't easy. She said afterward that she lost 1.6 liters of blood in the hospital and required a blood transfusion, but fortunately, she was able to come home to recover after a few days in the hospital. She shares her daughter with her husband, musician Tyler Ward. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Baby's Here! Elle King + Daniel Tooker King and Tooker welcomed a son named Royal into the world in 2025, announcing the news in a social media post on Feb. 28. The couple are also parents to a 3-and-a-half-year-old son named Lucky. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Baby's Here! Hardy + Caleigh Hardy Hardy and his wife Caleigh are first-time parents to a baby girl named Rosie. The couple got married in October 2022, and they announced her pregnancy two years later, in October 2024. Baby girl Hardy was due in February, but Caleigh's pregnancy went a little past her due date, and Rosie was finally born on March 7. Matt Winkelmeyer, Getty Images Baby's Here! Koe Wetzel + Bailey Fisher Rising country star Koe Wetzel and his girlfriend Bailey Fisher welcomed their first child , a baby girl, on May 23, 2025. They shared an adorable collection of newborn photos to introduce their daughter, whose named is Woods Madison, to the world. Matt Winkelmeyer, Getty Images Baby's Here! Sam Hunt + Hannah Lee Fowler Hunt and his wife Hannah Lee are quickly making their family into a "House Party": They welcomed their third child , a boy named Weyman, in May.
The news didn't get out until early July, which is pretty typical for this couple. Hunt and his wife tend to stay tight-lipped about their personal life, and they didn't share their baby news with the world until some time after the fact with their first two kids, either.
Brett Carlsen, Getty Images Baby's Here! Lauren Alaina + Cam Arnold Lauren Alaina and her husband Cam Arnold became first-time parents with the arrival of their daughter, Beni Doll, on June 11. When Alaina announced her pregnancy back in January, she had some help from a very special music video for her song, "Those Kind of Women." Alaina also celebrated her daughter's birth with music, releasing a new song called "Heaven Sent." Jason Kempin, Getty Images Baby's Here! Jordan Davis + Kristen Davis Jordan Da﻿vis and his wife expanded their crew on July 2 with the birth of their fourth child! Baby girl Sadie joins her older sister Eloise, and older brothers Locklan and Elijah. That means that Davis now has four young kids at home, and from the sound of his recent interview with Taste of Country Nights, it seems like he and his wife are done having babies after Sadie's birth. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Baby's Here! Travis Denning + Madison Montgomery Travis Denning and his wife Madison welcomed baby girl Charlotte on July 13. She's the couple's first child, and has a TON of country music royalty in her extended family.
Not only is dad a country hitmaker, but Montgomery is the daughter of John Michael Montgomery. Little Charlotte's great-uncle is Montgomery Gentry's Eddie Montgomery, and her uncle is singer-songwriter Walker Montgomery. Big shoes to fill if this little lady decides to pursue a country music career down the line! Rick Diamond, Getty Images Baby's Here! Lady A's Hillary Scott + Chris Tyrrell Lady A frontwoman Hillary Scott and her husband Chris Tyrrell welcomed baby girl No. 4 on July 25. They chose her name, Selah Jean, because it means "pause and reflect" and "God is gracious," the couple said when she made her arrival.
Scott and Tyrrell are already parents to 11-year-old Eisele as well as seven-year-old twins Betsy and Emory. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Lady A's Charles Kelley + Cassie McConnell That's right — not one but two members of Lady A are expanding their family this year. Charles Kelley and his wife Cassie are expecting their second child in "early fall," and in their announcement , they said the pregnancy was the "biggest surprise of our lives." They're already parents to a 9-year-old son named Ward. Rick Diamond, Getty Images Baby's Here! Sadie Robertson Huff + Christian Huff Duck Dynasty star Sadie Robertson Huff and her husband Christian Huff welcomed baby girl No. 3 on Aug. 1.
Their newest little one, Kit Carroway, has a special middle name that she inherited both from her mama and from the Duck Dynasty matriarch, Miss Kay Robertson. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Baby's Here! Cole Swindell + Courtney Little Cole Swindell and his wife Courtney became first-time parents in August 2025, when they welcomed their daughter, Rainey Gail. The couple have been married since last June. Chris Saucedo, Getty Images Baby's Here! Toby Keith's Son Stelen Covel + His Wife Haley Covel Toby Keith's fourth grandchild arrived in August. The late singer's son Stelen and his wife Haley welcomed a baby girl named Millie Brooks. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Scotty + Gabi McCreery Scotty McCreery and his wife Gabi will be second-time parents this fall. They shared the big news on social media in May, posting a spread of family maternity photos that spotlights their two-year-old son, Avery. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Hailey Whitters + Jake Gear Hailey Whitters and her husband Jake Gear are expecting their first child , a baby boy, late this fall. They announced their happy news with some farm-themed maternity shots -- an appropriate setting for the couple, who also posed for pictures in front of corn stalks to celebrate both their engagement and their wedding. Getty Images Thomas Rhett + Lauren Atkins Thomas Rhett and his wife Lauren announced in August that they're expecting their fifth child together.
The couple are already parents to four daughters, and there's no word yet on whether this baby will continue the streak or be the couple's first boy. They also didn't share a due date, so Baby No. 5 might show up in 2026. Jason Kempin, Getty Images Maybe Baby: Jelly Roll + Bunnie Xo Okay, so there hasn't yet been any official pregnancy announcement from the DeFord household. But Jelly Rol l and his wife Bunn﻿ie Xo have been open about their hopes to have a baby in 2025 via in vitro fertilization (IVF) and surrogacy, and they've also said they intend to stay pretty quiet while they're in the midst of the process. If they do have a baby this year, fans should likely expect a surprise announcement after their bundle of joy is already born.
